name: dsh-diagrams
description: Diagrams (row `dsh-diagrams`, tab kinds `diagram` / `diagrams`): Mermaid and TikZ LaTeX diagrams as a first-class vn-harness surface. The model gets four tools (diagram_write/patch/read/delete) that validate every diagram on the host - Mermaid is parsed headlessly by the same vendored engine the browser renders with, TikZ is compiled by the machine's own TeX engine - plus two bundled skills that teach Mermaid and TikZ craft. Each diagram becomes a real right-bar tab with a rendered view, a source drawer and an export menu, and every tool call renders the diagram inline in the conversation with a link that opens that tab. State is per-conversation and survives restarts; artifacts are content-addressed and cached. No core patches, no fork, no npm dependencies, no network. Alpha.
